title: Advance artifact readiness next actions after shadow observation contract
user_business_goal: After the shadow detector metadata bridge, dry-run endpoint, and observation request contract are merged, the artifact readiness report should guide the coordinator to the next safe metadata loop instead of reopening the completed shadow integration issue.
out_of_scope: raw media, raw datasets, customer/factory data, notebooks, model weights, TensorRT engines, model binaries, or model execution
live camera capture, camera SDK loading, camera credentials, GPU/hardware validation, or hardware readiness approval
production deploy/release, secrets, tokens, provider credentials, destructive migrations, production data migration, billing, legal/compliance behavior, or security boundary change
product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model promotion approval, production PASS/NG authority, or production auto-reject behavior
acceptance_criteria: artifact_readiness_report.v1 keeps shadow model production authority false and model promotion blocked.
Valid artifact intake advances the shadow model lane to a post-integration review state instead of ready_for_shadow_integration.
The shadow model lane recommends shadow_observation_review instead of shadow_model_integration.
recommended_next_actions includes submit_shadow_observation_payload and excludes open_shadow_model_integration_issue for the valid template intake path.
Missing or invalid artifact intake still recommends fix_artifact_intake or configure_artifact_intake as before.
HMI can render the new next action text from /artifact-readiness/status without layout or authority changes.
Existing artifact intake, detector, HMI, feedback, product CI, and full repo tests continue to pass.
required_checks: HTTP preview smoke for /artifact-readiness/status when local preview is available

memory_preflight.query: FQV2 artifact readiness shadow model integration complete observation request contract next actions.
retrieved_decisions: Shadow detector metadata bridge, dry-run endpoint, and shadow observation request contract are merged.
Detector output remains review-only and production authority false.
Model promotion, production release, QC/SOP tolerance approval, and live camera approval remain human gates.
retrieved_lessons: Readiness next actions should reflect completed implementation stages.
The next safe app loop is sanitized shadow observation metadata validation and QC feedback collection.
memory_preflight.conflicts_found: runtime/Windmill daily attention is a non-app-code auth/session blocker; this task does not require Windmill secret access.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-044 PR to restore the previous artifact readiness next-action wording. Existing artifact intake, detector status, shadow observation validator, HMI, feedback, and product CI behavior remain valid.
